purpose: Reusable bottom-layer schema for DOI-verified catalysis reaction records. It is designed for reaction facts, condition normalization, active-phase evidence, and later joins to the MOF identity registry.
purposeZh: 面向 DOI 核验催化反应记录的底层通用 schema，用于保存反应事实、条件归一化、活性相证据，并为后续接入 MOF 身份库保留连接字段。

recordContract.criticalMetricPolicy: Numeric catalytic metrics may be stored only when extracted from a verified publisher page, DOI landing page, institutional repository, or explicitly cited bibliographic page. Otherwise the metric must stay null or be omitted with status not-extracted.
recordContract.criticalMetricPolicyZh: 只有从已核验的出版方页面、DOI 页面、机构知识库或明确文献页面提取到的数值，才能写入性能指标；否则必须保留为空或标记为 not-extracted。

normalizationRules.label: Potential reference
normalizationRules.rule: Store electrochemical potentials as numeric V vs RHE only when the source explicitly reports vs RHE. Do not convert from another reference without source-side conversion details.
normalizationRules.ruleZh: 只有来源明确报告为 vs RHE 时，才以 V vs RHE 数值写入；没有来源换算细节时不从其他参比自行换算。

normalizationRules.label: Partial current density
normalizationRules.rule: Use this formula only when total current density and product Faradaic efficiency are measured under the same condition. Otherwise record only source-reported partial current density.
normalizationRules.ruleZh: 仅当总电流密度与产物法拉第效率来自同一条件时使用该式；否则只记录来源直接报道的分电流密度。

normalizationRules.label: Condition comparability
normalizationRules.rule: Records are same-condition comparable only when cell type, electrolyte, potential/current mode, product quantification method, duration, and catalyst loading basis are all present and aligned.
normalizationRules.ruleZh: 只有电解池类型、电解液、电位/电流模式、产物定量方法、持续时间和催化剂负载基准均存在且一致时，才允许同条件比较。

normalizationRules.label: Active-phase boundary
normalizationRules.rule: Keep pristine MOF, MOF-derived material, in situ reconstructed phase, and post-reaction phase separate. A precursor MOF is not automatically the proven active phase.
normalizationRules.ruleZh: 原始 MOF、MOF 衍生材料、原位重构相和反应后相必须分开；前驱体 MOF 不能自动视为已证明的活性相。

identityJoinRules.rule: Join to mof_identity_registry only by exact CSD Refcode, CCDC identifier, explicit canonicalId, or a curated registry alias with matching source provenance.
identityJoinRules.ruleZh: 接入 mof_identity_registry 只能使用精确 CSD Refcode、CCDC 编号、明确 canonicalId，或有来源证明的人工核验别名。

identityJoinRules.rule: A shared DOI may connect evidence to an article but does not establish structure-level identity.
identityJoinRules.ruleZh: 相同 DOI 只能说明来自同一论文，不能单独建立结构级身份连接。

nonClaims: This schema does not convert literature records into validated material recommendations.
This schema does not rank catalysts across incompatible electrochemical conditions.
This schema does not infer active phases without in situ, operando, post-reaction, or computational evidence.
nonClaimsZh: 该 schema 不把文献记录转化为已验证材料推荐。
该 schema 不跨不兼容电化学条件给催化剂排名。
该 schema 不在缺少原位、操作态、反应后或计算证据时推断活性相。
